ledger_definition: Iterate selected original tensor indices ascending, then sorted local slots; append dict(index,name,slot,bytes,sha256) from actual read bytes; SHA256 of json.dumps(ledger,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode().
reproduction: With JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu, inspect_source_inventory at the recorded path and verify its canonical hash. Call read_ws32_layer_subset_metadata with the recorded root, layer6, slots, geometry from configs/glm-5.2-fp8-config.json, byte budget and expected manifest/success/mesh/topology hashes. Iterate iter_ws32_layer_subset_host_tensors and rederive the ledger/count/bytes. No device load or JAX backend initialization is required.
limitations: Controller four retained owners only; other seven hosts still require fresh guarded preflight and selected tensor validation.
Selected layer6 leaves only; no full-file payload or unselected layer validation.
Pinned topology metadata, not a live physical topology or accelerator census.
No new checkpoint, TPU arithmetic, measured HBM, full-layer performance or model admission.
